description.value: French Creek Bistro is a casual breakfast-and-lunch restaurant near Parksville on Vancouver Island, offering a broad all-day breakfast menu alongside soups, hot sandwiches, burgers, and fish and chips. The bistro occupies its own building on Wembley Road and presents a straightforward, hearty menu well suited to hungry riders looking for a proper sit-down meal. An unusual dessert offering — Gulab Jamun with ice cream — gives the menu a distinctive personal touch.
